metadata.title: Aika World – About
metadata.description: Meet the creators of Aika World and discover the principles that guide our storytelling.

title: About
intro: Aika World is an independent creative initiative built on detailed storytelling, memorable characters and shared community experiences.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: We craft a world where choices matter, character growth is trackable and every adventure reveals a new layer.

team.title: The team
team.description: Writers, illustrators and system designers work side by side to deliver the next chapters.

approach.title: Our approach
approach.description: Every piece of lore is documented so storytellers and players can follow the evolution of Aika.
